author: Nintendo of America
description:
Play Just Dance: Decades of Hits now on Nintendo Switch 2: https://ninten.do/6003ah88b

With this brand new entry, Just Dance unites all dancers through 6 decades of hits! Featuring artists such as: 
- "NUEVAYoL" by Bad Bunny 
- "Manchild" by Sabrina Carpenter 
- "Danza Kuduro" by Lucenzo & Don Omar 
- "Turn Down for What" by DJ Snake & Lil Jon 
- "Hello" by Martin Solveig & Dragonette 
- "Feel Good Inc." by Gorillaz 
- "Bye Bye Bye" by NSYNC 
- "Wannabe" by Spice Girls 
- "No Scrubs" by TLC 
- "It's Tricky" by Run DMC 
- "Uptown Girl" by Billy Joel 
- "Mamma Mia" by ABBA 
- … and more! 

#JustDance2027 #JustDanceDecadesofHits #EveryEraOneFloor
